method: Read-only native instruction tracing; owned SwiftUI accessibility reconstruction inspected through CUA.

findings.finding: An explicit accessibility label comes from 0x1026a97a8.
Capture — followed by the capture title.
File — followed by the file display name.

owned_native_probe: CUA exposes named buttons; primary button activation increments the owned row counter. Ordinary Tab/Space did not activate the row with the current macOS keyboard-navigation setting.
limits: The partial SwiftUI reconstruction propagates its accessibility label to multiple children; it does not prove the production Arc accessibility hierarchy.
No claim of exact keyboard-navigation or VoiceOver interaction parity; labels, button trait and accessible primary action are the verified scope.
Read-only Arc menu inspection did not produce a live hover preview. No source setting was changed.
